about: One row per shipped brands id: the sha256 of the payload that was reviewed against its caption, the verdict (ok or mismatch), who reviewed it and when. A row counts only while the artwork still has that hash. For this catch-all, ok means two things and no more: on the 58 review pages nothing was drawn under a caption it visibly contradicts, and the brand domain Simple Icons records as the mark's source belongs to the captioned brand, its owner or its press kit. Most of these brands cannot be recognised by eye, so ok is not a claim that each mark is its brand's current logo. Regenerate the pages with: node skills/arkitect-drawio/scripts/contact-sheet.mjs --pack brands --review (#72).

brands/nebula.note: the nebula.tv streaming service; not NebulaGraph (databases/nebula, #81)

brands/vespa.note: Piaggio's Vespa scooter, which is what Simple Icons names; not Vespa.ai (databases/vespa, #81)
